contents.text: What did Microsoft's statement of stockholders' equity show for common stock cash dividends in fiscal year 2026?

Microsoft's statement of stockholders' equity showed that common stock cash dividends in fiscal year 2026 were $27,034 million. (Source: MSFT-10K-2026.html, PART II > Item 8. FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AND SUPPLEMENTARY DATA > STOCKHOLDERS’ EQUITY)
